zh.title: 换房规划：先买还是先卖，资金和 Prop 19 怎么算
zh.seo_title: 湾区换房规划：先买还是先卖｜陈靖
zh.description: 比较先卖后买、先买后卖和 Contingent offer，解释 HELOC 与 Bridge loan 的风险，并说明 55 岁以上房主如何用 Prop 19 转移税基，以及时间和文件怎么安排。
zh.lead: 换房同时是一次卖房和一次买房，难点在时间和资金衔接。这篇比较几条路径，帮你在开始看房前想清楚顺序。

en.title: Move-Up Planning: Buy First or Sell First, Financing and Prop 19
en.seo_title: Move-Up Planning: Buy or Sell First | Jing Chen
en.description: Compare selling first, buying first and contingent offers, weigh HELOCs and bridge loans, and see how Prop 19 base year transfers work if you are 55+.
en.lead: A move-up is a sale and a purchase at once, and the hard part is connecting them. Compare the main paths before you start touring homes.
